clips.title: The story
paras: Grub waits east of the Crossroads, hungry for a pot of dig rat stew. He sends travelers to Bael Modan in the southern Barrens to bring back dig rats for his recipe.

Across the dry Barrens, hunters bring down zhevras, plainstriders, and raptors. Grub, an orc camping east of the Crossroads, craves something different: dig rats. He says he is hungry all day and offers to share his recipe with any traveler willing to catch the burrowing rodents.

Bael Modan lies deep in the southern Barrens, where dwarven prospectors dig into the red earth. Their work has disturbed nests of dig rats. The dwarves see the small rodents as an infestation, while Grub sees a feast close to the excavation.

Grub says dig rats taste best after rotting for several weeks. For a hungry traveler who wants food now, he accepts fresher meat. His recipe shows how forgiving roadside cooking can be on Kalimdor's frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: An adventurer like you must get pretty hungry out here in The Barrens. Me, I'm starving all day long.
Tell you what, I'll fix you up a nice stew. Just need a few dig rats.
Seems those filthy dwarves at Bael Modan are overrun with everyone's favorite feast. Now head on down south to Bael Modan and bring me back some dig rats.
You can't call yourself a seasoned adventurer until you've spent some time killing rats! Haw!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Whack enough dig rats yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Normally I don't like to eat these rodents when they're so.... So... Ripe. Like to let them rot for a few weeks to really bring out the flavor. But you look so hungry.
Let me fix you some Dig Rat Stew. Ah, there we go.
